method: Same recorded start state for image interventions. True absence moves ball to world [100,100,100] without stepping; segmentation verifies visibility. First two actions execute before replanning; full chunks retained for inspection. No success inferred. States and images mixed across phases are counterfactuals.
data_thresholds: 10 Hz: arm stationary if all five arm increments <0.25 deg; shoulder mismatch if increment <0.2 deg and |leader-follower| >10 deg. These are descriptive flags, not proof of mechanical stall or task phase.
